```plato

// A well-known RGB color space, for when a name is enough and the full
// RgbColorSpace record is not needed.
type NamedColorSpace
    = SRGB
    | LinearSRGB
    | DisplayP3
    | AdobeRGB
    | ProPhotoRGB
    | Rec709
    | Rec2020
    | ACEScg
    | ACES2065;
```
